original_target.title: Automatic conservation laws for renormalized nonlinear diffusion
original_target.area: Nonlinear diffusion PDEs; chemical mass conservation

scope_comparison: Actual published Definition1.1 equations1.4–1.6 and Remark1.2 distinguish the extra conservation axiom from the truncated identity for nonlinear exponents. Theorem1.3 constructs selected conservative solutions, not all identity-only solutions. Theorem1.7 assumes additional integrability. No automatic conservation theorem for exact local class located.
